name: crew-board
description: Plan and subagent progress above the prompt, plus a crew panel (/crew): running, finished and planned subagents with model, effort, steps, context, cost and time.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel
autoOpen.description: plan: when a plan is reported; any: also when any subagent starts

stepInclude.title: Ask these plugin agents for steps
stepInclude.description: Comma-separated agent types with a ":" (plugin agents) whose brief still gets the step request

stepExclude.title: Never ask these agents for steps
stepExclude.description: Comma-separated agent types whose brief never gets the step request
